title: Two-person evidence review record (ACVP remediation plan J-5)
description: One file per reviewed item, named <anything>.review.json in this directory. Written by the reviewers, never generated. Enforced by src/data/validation/reviewRecords.ts via npm run gen:release-evidence:check: two distinct named reviewers (source verification and claim review), ISO dates not in the future, an item id listed in public/data/validation/release-evidence.json reviews.items, and the subject SHA-256 the reviewers saw (a record whose subject has since changed is shown as stale-review, not as a review).

item.description: Review item id, e.g. vector-source:mldsa_sigver_test or coverage-waiver:baseline-CKM_RSA_PKCS.

subjectSha256.description: The item's subjectSha256 at review time (print it with npm run gen:release-evidence -- --print-review-items).

author.description: Who authored the test, source import or claim under review.

reviewer.description: A person's full name — not a role, not a placeholder.
